note: Full-stack safe replay family (roadmap P0). These tasks run the PRODUCTION harness — extensions, skills, prompts, AGENTS.md, memory boot — in a disposable credential-free sandbox, not the arm-only runner that disables every layer. External effects (pass, notify-send, paplay, curl, gh, pi-text) are shims that log instead of acting; the model is a scripted loopback provider, so a run is deterministic and costs $0. Verifiers are judge-owned and read only sandbox observations.

tasks.why: memory-boot, skills and AGENTS.md are exactly what run.py's -ne -ns -nc flags remove; a harness that silently stops loading them is invisible to the arm-only suite
tasks.prompt: Reply with exactly REPLAY-OK and nothing else.
